name: How to Order Custom Aluminum Extrusion from Jiju Aluminium
description: Step-by-step guide for B2B buyers to commission a custom aluminum extrusion project with Shandong Jiju Aluminium — from initial RFQ submission through ocean shipment.

estimatedCost.value: Quote on application; dies USD 200–1,500, material from USD 2.30/kg FOB Qingdao

supply.name: Surface finish specification (anodized, powder coated, etc.)

step.name: Submit your RFQ
step.text: Send your profile drawing (DWG/DXF/STEP/PDF), target alloy, surface finish, length, tolerance, volume and target market to info@jijualuminium.com or our online RFQ form. JIJU acknowledges within 4 working hours.

step.name: Engineering DFM review
step.text: Our R&D team reviews your drawing for extrudability — wall thickness ratios, tongue ratios, corner radii, symmetry — and returns an annotated DFM report with optimization suggestions and a die-cost estimate within 24 hours.

step.name: Receive formal quotation
step.text: JIJU issues a formal proforma invoice covering die cost, unit price per kg or per linear meter, surface treatment, packing, lead time and Incoterm (default FOB Qingdao). Quotation is valid for 30 days.

step.name: Confirm order, pay die deposit, approve sample
step.text: Sign the proforma invoice, pay 100% of the die cost plus 30% T/T deposit. JIJU manufactures the die in 7–12 days and runs a 3–6 m extrusion sample; we courier the sample for dimensional and finish approval.

step.name: Mass production
step.text: Once the sample is approved, mass production runs on the matched extrusion press, followed by surface treatment, cut-to-length, deep processing (CNC, drilling, machining) and packing in fumigation-free wooden pallets. Weekly production photos are shared via WhatsApp.

step.name: Shipping & after-sales
step.text: After 70% balance T/T is settled against the B/L copy, goods are loaded at Qingdao port (FCL 20′/40′HQ or LCL). JIJU provides packing list, commercial invoice, mill test certificate, certificate of origin, and tracks the shipment until arrival. After-sales team is on standby for claims and reorders.
